item.title: Version 1.2.29 (Build 20261117)
item.description:
What's New

fix(telex): keep the word literal after undoing a non-adjacent circumflex

Typing "queuee" undoes the free-mark ê ("quêu" -> "queue") and sets

tempDisableKey, but the vRestore branch then calls insertKey, whose

phonetic checkSpelling() ignores vowel clusters and re-enables marks.

The next tone key landed on an invalid cluster: "queuees" -> "queúe",

"keuees" -> "keúe". Adjacent undo ("teees") was only safe because of

the three-identical-vowels rule.

Keep tempDisableKey set after a circumflex undo (a/e/o) so the rest of

the word stays literal. dd, mark and w undo are unchanged. Affects

Telex and Simple Telex 1/2; VNI was never affected (its undo key is a

digit).

Bump version to 1.2.29 (20261117).

Refs #339
